Simple pendulum — from upload to simulation

Actual input · expected input · actual output · expected output · error propagation

Trace: TRACE-PENDULUM-20261016-003-NATIVE-RETRY-20261017

Trace ID: `TRACE-PENDULUM-20261016-003-NATIVE-RETRY-20261017`. These documents use the existing live native Windows request from 2026-10-17. No models, detectors or solvers were rerun while writing them. No production fixes were made. Source reference: A fixed mounting point on a horizontal support, a string to a bob displaced to the right, a vertical reference, and symbolic θ, L and m labels. Known and unknown evidence: The source supplies no numerical L, m or θ. Pivot, bob, radius and initial visual angle can be grounded geometrically. Meter scale, mass and gravity require explicit assumptions or other evidence. Expected geometry for this diagram: The pivot must agree with the mounting point/support; the string must connect that pivot to the bob. Bob segmentation is not evidence for the pivot. Record disagreement rather than accepting inconsistent constraints. Expected initial simulation: At t=0 pivot and bob should register to their printed locations. Motion should pivot around that fixed point. No exact period can be asserted from the symbolic source alone. Exact expected coordinates/masks are unavailable: EXPECTED ARTIFACT NOT AVAILABLE — NO GROUND TRUTH EXISTS. Expected behavior below is a contract or a qualitative source comparison, never a hand-drawn expected result.

Markdown document · Original forensic call index

How to use this document

Read stages 01–34 in order. Blue panels show recorded data; green panels show expected contracts and source-specific requirements. Full snapshots are expandable. Mutation output is distinguished from a None/undefined function return. Earlier startup/demo events are excluded. A structural pass does not certify visual registration.

“NOT EXECUTED” means the branch did not run. “Not separately captured” means an internal operation was reached but its own call arguments were not intercepted. No expected pixels or runtime outputs have been invented.

Ordered pipeline

  1. Browser selects the original diagram
  2. HTTP request reaches /api/ingest
  3. Upload persistence and dimension decoding
  4. PageIR / whole-figure coordinate frame
  5. Actual Gemini request and response
  6. Semantic validation, confidence caps and thresholds

  8. Evidence dispatch and source decode
  9. RapidOCR: first text/box observations

  11. Symbol candidates, deduplication and final OCR
  12. Grayscale, blur and edge extraction
  13. OCR-region suppression before geometry detection
  14. Domain CV: raw candidates → selected geometry
  15. SAM2 segmentation prompted by CV
  16. Semantic-to-spatial grounding and parameter binding
  17. Grounded BookIR and OCR-enriched PageIR
  18. Enforce authoritative source dimensions
  19. Automatic resolution and explicit policy values
  20. Resolution decisions, units and calibration
  21. Requirement and ambiguity analysis
  22. Readiness decision
  23. PhysicsCompiler entry and gate
  24. Canonical scene construction and schema validation
  25. API response delivered to the browser
  26. Frontend receives result and selects next state
  27. Review / explicit compile request branch
  28. InteractiveFigure receives the compiled scene
  29. FigureViewport background and layout
  30. PhysicsRuntime normalization and adapter initialization
  31. Domain solver and actual initial state
  32. CoordinateMapper: source → overlay → browser
  33. Actual renderer at t=0 over the original
  34. Activation, motion and reset

Expected output

Consistent resolved units and explicit calibration provenance. A scale derived using assumed physical length must remain assumption-derived; it is not measured ground truth.

For this diagram

The source supplies no numerical L, m or θ. Pivot, bob, radius and initial visual angle can be grounded geometrically. Meter scale, mass and gravity require explicit assumptions or other evidence.

What changed and what may have been lost

Several calls can occur inside auto-resolution. Exact invocation records are kept separately; null return can mean calibration was unavailable, not that a zero scale was measured.

Expected output

Satisfied/missing requirements, issues, blockers and warnings consistent with available evidence. Visual correctness and mere field presence must be evaluated separately.

For this diagram

The source supplies no numerical L, m or θ. Pivot, bob, radius and initial visual angle can be grounded geometrically. Meter scale, mass and gravity require explicit assumptions or other evidence.

What changed and what may have been lost

The current analyzer checks required entities/parameters and ambiguity. It does not compare every proposed line or point to image pixels.

The source supplies no numerical L, m or θ. Pivot, bob, radius and initial visual angle can be grounded geometrically. Meter scale, mass and gravity require explicit assumptions or other evidence.

sourceToView includes viewport letterboxing; sourceToOverlay omits it because the overlay is already image-aligned. Browser coordinates add the measured image origin. Do not add letterboxing twice.

Expected output

Motion evolves runtime state only; reset restores initial compiled values. Exact 0.5 s / 1 s states cannot be asserted unless their saved timestamps say so.

For this diagram

At t=0 pivot and bob should register to their printed locations. Motion should pivot around that fixed point. No exact period can be asserted from the symbolic source alone.

What changed and what may have been lost

The executed main.js path automatically starts after a successful load. Later frames are saved at their actual times. Optics results are static ray solutions rather than pendulum-like time evolution.

Complete handoff JSON

Runtime subcomponents and capture boundary

These internal components are distinguished explicitly so a saved outer runtime result is not mistaken for six separate function traces.

ComponentExpected inputExpected outputActual evidence / gap
validatePhysicsSceneNormalized canonical sceneValidation result / typed issuesNot separately intercepted; successful load shows continuation, not a saved validation-result object.
SimulationCapabilityRegistry.resolveValidated normalized sceneInteractive scene/capabilitiesNo separate before/after capture. Use PhysicsRuntime source and actual runtime boundary; do not assume its output equals its input.
SolverRegistry.resolveInteractive sceneMatching domain adapterNo separately serialized adapter return. Runtime domain/output and the executed load path establish the adapter route.
Adapter.initializeInteractive scene, container and optionsInitialized adapter stateInitial runtime output/state is captured, but this child call’s exact argument object is not separately recorded.
Domain solverAdapter-derived model argumentsPhysics solution/stateActual solution/state is captured. Exact internal solver-call arguments are not a separate artifact.
Renderer.render / PendulumSimulation.renderRuntime solution/state and mapperSVG/canvas outputActual SVG/canvas and DOM measurements are captured; per-draw-call arguments are not.

Appendix B. First failure and propagation

Last known good: Exact source, correct semantic pendulum roles and symbolic OCR; no printed numeric length/mass is claimed.

First suspicious: Selected visible string begins at (556,67), extending into the mounting hatch region.

First definitive failure: CV accepts a pivot above the detected support while reporting the disagreement in its own validation metadata.

Downstream chain: SAM2 independently finds bob centroid=(841.8054054054054,650.2034594594595), bbox=(804,612,75,76), area=4625. Grounder retains the CV bob/pivot; CV–SAM agreement is about 1.23 px. SAM verifies the bob, not the pivot. String length is rounded from 634.6110579092531 to 634.61 px. Length=1 m, mass=1 kg, gravity=9.80665 m/s² and damping=0 are policy values. L and m in the source are symbols, not evidence for those numbers. Calibration derives from policy length, so it is not a measured textbook scale. Compiler preserves pivot and 634.61-pixel string; initialAngle=26.117406100584446°. The actual runtime reset kernel has theta=0.45583472853565193 rad and simTime=0. Its own getBobSourcePosition() returns (841.3629149366802,649.0505493762439). The tiny bob difference is rounding; the pivot error was already in CV.

Separation of failure classes: preprocessing/perception is demonstrated upstream; a shared coordinate conversion error is not demonstrated; numerical solver failure is not established. The circuit never reaches a solver.

Appendix C. Capture limits

No new run was performed. The recorder captured repository Python boundaries and GenAI model calls, not private neural-library/C internals. JS boundary events, normalized scenes, actual solver outputs and DOM captures exist; separate entry/exit snapshots for every registry/adapter/renderer child function do not. These gaps are labeled, not filled with reconstructed output. Several void JS returns appear as captureError because undefined is not JSON; resulting state is separately recorded. Two class-serialization errors exist in the historical recorder log; integrity verification found the required snapshot files present for every indexed call. No exact expected pixel dataset, mask or numerical physical state has been authored.
